about_the_game:
Project X

Welcome to Project X, a first-person survival horror experience that traps you in the cold, dark corridors of an abandoned subway station. What begins as a routine visit turns into a chilling fight for your life when you find yourself trapped underground… and you're not alone.

Something is down here with you.

It doesn't speak.
It doesn't breathe.
It doesn't even make a sound when it moves.
But it knows you're here.

Key Features:

  • Unnerving Atmosphere: Explore a pitch-black, decaying subway system filled with ambient dread and eerie stillness. The only sounds you'll hear... are your own.

  • Sound-Based Stealth: The creature can’t hear, but that doesn't mean you're safe. It moves without warning and without sound—making every shadow, every turn, and every silence a potential death sentence.

  • Puzzle-Based Escape: Solve environmental puzzles, find hidden pathways, and piece together the tragic story of what happened in the station before it's your turn to disappear.

  • Dynamic AI: The monster doesn’t follow a script. It roams. It watches. It waits. You’ll never know when it’s near… until it’s too late.

  • Immersive Horror: Stunning visuals and immersive audio design plunge you into a claustrophobic nightmare. Can you keep your nerves long enough to escape?

You came here by choice.
Leaving… might not be an option.
